title: Object carousel hero
summary: The hero is a row of objects or media with the focused one centered and full, and its neighbors scaled down and faded.
use_when: Physical products, media outputs: things worth looking at.
recipe:
.item { transition: transform 500ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1), opacity 500ms ease; }
.item:not(.focus) { transform: scale(.55); opacity: .55; }
specimen_html: hover an object to focus it · neighbors at scale 0.55, back-out spring

evidence.measured: Curved 3D carousel of generated media around the headline
